shared_elements: relief carving in coarse pale stone
a row of rounded, crescent/U-shaped raised forms along the upper part
suggestion of an animal head/beak-like profile
bold outlined shapes standing proud of a plain background
justification: Both show pale weathered stone worked in relief, and each has a band of rounded, crescent-like lobes across the upper zone above a larger curved animal-like head form, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat slab organised into ordered registers of shallow, linear, clearly legible figures (quadruped, birds, human-like figure, hatched band), while B is a fragmentary block carved in heavy, rounded, almost three-dimensional volumes with no register scheme and no linear detail.
